name: astrotalk_reference_2002
verified_against: TWO independent references. (1) AstroTalk (astrotalk.com) free kundli, 2026-08 — planetary positions, D9 navamsa, panchang, avakhada and avastha tables. (2) A kundali hand-cast for this same birth by a Nepali guru, confirmed by the subject: 15 of 17 values agree, including lagna, Moon rashi and navamsa, Mula pada 2, the Ketu dasha, Dhruva yoga, Poush/Hemant/Uttarayana, Samvat 2058, Shaka 1923, Jaya samvatsara, Dog yoni, Rakshasa gana, Adi nadi and the syllable यो — the syllable the subject was actually named from. Engine 0.4.0, topocentric.
why: The best-verified fixture in the set: an independent implementation and a hand-cast kundali agree on it, and the subject confirmed the birth time. Its two remaining divergences from the guru are recorded in fixtures/textbook/kapoor_2011.json under hand_cast_kundali_2002.
